body:
REWORK #2638 (TASK-1748): one blocker. Everything else is approved.

BLOCKER: aida-cli-lib/tests/path_isolation_guardrail.rs:140 and :158 treat ANY call to a fn/method named `lock` as authorization to mutate HOME or PATH. With 94 `.lock()` calls in scope (stdout().lock(), Mutex locks...), a raw set_var("PATH"/"HOME") next to any of them passes the guard. That also weakens the existing BUG-1994 PATH guard.
  Scenario: a test calls `let _o = std::io::stdout().lock(); std::env::set_var("PATH", ..)`, and the guard accepts it.
FIX (pick one, prefer the first):
  (a) Convert aida-cli/tests/bug_1926_store_identity_push.rs:306,310 to require_path_mutation_scope / run_path_isolated_test, and drop the `lock` exemption entirely; or
  (b) Narrow the exemption to the specific named lock (e.g. ENV_LOCK in that file).
  Add a guardrail self-test proving that `stdout().lock()` + raw set_var("HOME") is REJECTED.
Optional, cheap: replace the whole-file skip of test_home.rs (:181) with an allow-comment on line 357; also scan remove_var("HOME").
Done when: the new head is pushed, Build is green, and you post "FACTORY READY #2638 at <sha>".
Note: TASK-1748 was still draft/unowned; I have approved it. Claim it before you push.
subject: REWORK #2638 (TASK-1748): guardrail lock loophole
